purpose: Primary-source and official-documentation support for a bounded ML methods assessment; proposed experiments only, no training or new performance measurements.

scope.confirmed_material: Fresh graphite–Si/SiOx, confirmed directly by Santosh on 2026-10-03; exact chemistry and pixelwise labels remain unknown.
scope.known_labels: Provider-confirmed supplier-batch membership is known. Acceptable/defective outcomes and independent phase/instance truth are absent.
scope.statistical_unit: Site; physical specimen independence remains unconfirmed. Patches, graph nodes and windows do not increase material sample n.
scope.status: Methods recommendation only. No adopted extraction, new model results, production edits or primary-KPI promotion.
scope.retrieval_limits: Abstract-only sources support the stated architecture/design motivation only. Benchmark performance and implementation details were not extrapolated to SEM electrodes. Direct publisher/author/official sources were used, not secondary tutorials. A blocked PatchCore full-paper retrieval was replaced with its author abstract and official implementation documentation.

sources.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
sources.retrieval_scope: Abstract and accessible full-text sections 7.1–7.3, including frozen-feature downstream evaluations.
sources.supports: Frozen pretrained visual features can be evaluated with lightweight/nonparametric downstream methods without fine-tuning the backbone.
sources.limit: Published natural-image/transfer benchmarks do not validate electrode morphology sensitivity or SEM acquisition invariance. Current cached tile CLS features are a project representation choice.

sources.title: Towards Total Recall in Industrial Anomaly Detection
sources.primary_source_type: Original research author abstract and authors' official implementation
sources.retrieval_scope: Author abstract plus official README quick guide and Training PatchCore sections. Publisher HTML returned 403; full PDF and attempted HTML were unavailable in this retrieval.
sources.supports: PatchCore uses a representative memory of nominal pretrained patch features; official implementation uses locally aggregated CNN features and coreset sampling.
sources.limit: No transfer of MVTec accuracy or nominal-training assumptions. Proposed DINO tile CLS balancing is an adaptation, not PatchCore reproduction, calibrated defect detection or a verified clean memory bank.

sources.title: Graph neural networks for an accurate and interpretable prediction of the properties of polycrystalline materials
sources.primary_source_type: Original research paper, corrected publisher full text
sources.retrieval_scope: Full Results and Methods text; graph construction, simulated 3-D dataset, supervised target and evaluation design inspected.
sources.supports: A microstructure GNN can represent physical grains/adjacency with grain attributes and supervised simulated property targets.
sources.limit: The material and supervision are simulated polycrystal magnetostriction, not 2-D electrode QC. No published accuracy, dataset-size sufficiency or computation speed is transferred. Image proximity edges are not physical grain/contact adjacency.

sources.title: Author Correction: Graph neural networks for an accurate and interpretable prediction of the properties of polycrystalline materials
sources.supports: The original code omitted message passing; the corrected implementation changed prediction and attribution figures/results.
sources.limit: Our no-edge/node-summary ablation recommendation is a methodological inference, not an empirical result on this project or a claim that message passing never helps.

sources.title: skimage.filters.gabor and gabor_kernel, scikit-image 0.23.2
sources.retrieval_scope: gabor/gabor_kernel definitions, parameter units, boundary convention and response arrays.
sources.supports: A Gabor filter is a fixed Gaussian-modulated sinusoidal convolution with frequency/orientation parameters and real/imaginary responses.
sources.limit: Chosen wavelengths/directions and energy summaries are proposed project definitions, not validated graphite-plate orientation or acquisition-invariant measurements.

sources.title: Invariant Scattering Convolution Networks
sources.supports: Fixed wavelet convolutions, modulus and averaging yield a translation-invariant, deformation-stable representation with higher-order texture information.
sources.limit: No claim of SEM contrast/charging invariance or electrode accuracy. Scattering is deferred; no dependency installed or numerical representation extracted.

sources.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
sources.primary_source_type: Original research author abstract and official lab publication/software page
sources.retrieval_scope: Author abstract and official lab page; annotated EM use and architecture motivation verified.
sources.supports: U-Net combines context and spatial localisation with augmentation for supervised segmentation; it was evaluated on annotated neuronal EM images.
sources.limit: No universal minimum label count or transfer of biomedical segmentation accuracy to graphite–Si/SiOx. Existing project masks must be independently reviewed before this experiment.

sources.title: High throughput quantitative metallography for complex microstructures using deep learning: A case study in ultrahigh carbon steel
sources.primary_source_type: Authors' official NIST publication record and abstract
sources.retrieval_scope: Official abstract; task, annotated dataset and derived distributions inspected. Linked full PDF not used for detailed performance claims.
sources.supports: Annotated material-micrograph CNN segmentation can support interpretable particle-size and denuded-zone width distributions.
sources.limit: Steel microconstituents are not electrode phases; no weights, label requirements or measurement accuracy is transferred.

sources.title: Vision Transformers Need Registers
sources.retrieval_scope: Author abstract; revised 2024 version metadata checked.
sources.supports: High-norm token artifacts can occur in ViT feature maps, including low-information backgrounds; registers address the reported artifact.
sources.limit: Not a measurement of artifacts in these current CLS embeddings or a reason to replace the cached model. Dense token maps require separate extraction and validation.

sources.title: OneClassSVM documentation
sources.retrieval_scope: Class purpose and nu parameter definition. Live docs identify version 1.9.1; local project uses sklearn 1.4. No version migration or runtime result claimed.
sources.supports: nu is an upper bound on training-error fraction and lower bound on support-vector fraction, not a calibrated QC false-alarm probability.
sources.limit: Library availability and parameter definitions do not support target-data performance or model calibration.

sources.title: Testing for Outliers with Conformal p-values
sources.authors: Bates, Candès, Lei, Romano and Sesia
sources.primary_source_type: Original research author preprint of Annals of Statistics paper
sources.retrieval_scope: Full-text introduction, train/calibration separation and marginal rank construction; rank lower bound also verified in proof text.
sources.supports: Outlier conformal calibration requires the specified reference/test distribution assumptions and fitting/calibration separation; ordinary nonrandomised ranks have minimum 1/(n_cal+1).
sources.limit: The arithmetic resolution example is not project calibration. Current heterogeneous reference, unknown specimen independence and reference-LOO novelty percentiles are not demonstrated conformal guarantees.

handoff: Parent owns shared plan, logs and candidate/metric register integration. New protocols remain unrun and excluded from primary/ML decision inputs until separately reviewed.
